verdict.rationale: Chroma is a vector database, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair axis. First-party docs describe a Chroma MCP server that lets Claude interact directly with Chroma's search capabilities, including persistent memory across conversations, and a probe confirms it is documented on the official integrations page. Missing for 10: details of the exposed tools and setup/configuration steps, evidence of support for agents beyond Claude, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the server working.
